items.new_text: Given a Supabase web app project whose lint configuration no longer carries the profile's architecture lint rules, when the build phase is checked, then every missing rule is reported as a failure that names the rule and the repair, a changed rule is only a warning, and the check passes once the rules are back.

Given the same project, when the repair is applied, then the missing rules are appended to the existing lint configuration without touching anything else, a second run changes nothing, and a configuration the tool cannot edit safely is reported and left untouched.
